extracted.intended_audience: students and coaches preparing/solving olympiad-style mathematical problems (high-school and undergraduate level)
extracted.subtask_description: A collection of competition-style problems (Juniors and Seniors) with full worked solutions spanning algebra, inequalities, geometry, functional equations, and integrals; intended as model solutions and practice material for problem solvers. The page presents problem statements, multiple solution approaches, remarks and equality/case conditions.
